title: AGENTREVIEW: Exploring Peer Review Dynamics with LLM Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Varying the number of reviewers aware of the authors' renowned identities and the percentage of non-anonymous papers, then measuring the deviation in final acceptance decisions using Jaccard index and Cohen's Kappa.
Comparing final review decisions with and without a rebuttal phase to determine if reviewers rely predominantly on their initial impressions of the submission despite author corrections.
Measuring the standard deviation of reviewer ratings before and after the Reviewer-Area Chair discussion phase to observe the convergence of opinions.
Substituting normal reviewers with malicious or irresponsible agents and analyzing the amplification of negative ratings, as well as the spillover effect on the scores of unbiased reviewers.
